visualCharacteristics: Full-bleed cross-fading media coupled with text cards: swipeable cards overlapping the media below 1280px, tiles under the media from 1280px (active tile opens its card); Mehr/Weniger anzeigen for long texts
contentPattern: One row per item: cell 1 = media (desktop, mobile[, tablet] images, or poster images + desktop/mobile video links), cell 2 = h3 title, paragraphs/lists, CTA paragraphs.
